verdict.rationale: No evidence of a general public API or OpenAPI/REST surface allowing UI-parity operations via API; probes for llms.txt and openapi spec both returned 404. Evidence only covers SDK error reporting, docs, integrations, and a separate MCP server product — none demonstrate API parity with the dashboard UI (e.g., managing rules, releases, stability targets via API). Missing for 10: public API/OpenAPI documentation, evidence of UI actions (assignment rules, releases, alerts config) being achievable via API.
